overview: Add an optional ExpiresAt to ShortUrl. Create computes ExpiresAt = now + expiresInMinutes using TimeProvider. The redirect path caches a CachedLink (target + expiry) and evaluates expiry on every request, returning 410 Gone for expired links without recording a click. Metadata and create responses expose expiresAt. No new endpoints.

fields.name: ExpiresAt
fields.notes: new nullable column; null = never expires (all existing rows)

endpoints.description: Create a short link; optional expiresInMinutes (1-525600)

nfrPatterns.nfr: Redirect latency must not regress (hot path)
nfrPatterns.pattern: Cache-aside storing target + expiry; expiry evaluated in memory
Additive, nullable schema and contract changes
nfrPatterns.buildingBlock: Nullable ExpiresAt column, optional request/response fields

decisions.title: 410 Gone for expired links
decisions.decision: Return 410 with problem details instead of 404.
decisions.rationale: Tells clients the link existed but is permanently unavailable; distinguishes expiry from typos.
decisions.alternatives: 404 (hides existence); redirect to an 'expired' page (needs UI, out of scope).

decisions.title: Relative expiry input, absolute storage
decisions.rationale: Avoids client clock skew and time-zone mistakes; absolute storage makes the check a simple comparison.

decisions.title: Check expiry on every request
decisions.decision: Cache the expiry with the target and compare on each redirect; keep cache TTL unchanged.
decisions.rationale: A cache entry can never serve an expired link, and no DB round-trip is added on cache hits.
decisions.alternatives: Shorten cache TTL to the remaining lifetime (more DB load, still racy across instances).

decisions.title: Keep expired rows
decisions.rationale: Statistics stay queryable; purge policy can be added later with the retention setting.

risks: Production databases need an EF Core migration adding the nullable expires_at column (development SQLite is recreated).
With a shared Redis cache, entries written by the previous version have a different shape; bump the cache key prefix when deploying.
